purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and schema-first anonymous geometry review.
assessment: Bauchi State Government publishes BAGIS property-registration guidelines and law. The official individual registration guide places the BAGIS Customer Service Centre at No. 5 Yakubun Bauchi Road, GRA Bauchi, within Bauchi metropolis, and describes cadastral-unit clearance for land-registration applications. This confirms a local official registration/cadastral institution, not public vector feature coverage. The official BAGIS pages and law establish property-registration and cadastral-administration services, but no anonymous parcel geometry service or safe native feature schema was identified. The registration process is an application/title workflow requiring documents; no application or parcel-specific record query was made.
